title: One-Step Inequalities
topic: Writing, solving, and graphing simple inequalities

items.prompt: Which value of x makes the inequality x > 5 true?
items.rationale: 6 is the only listed value greater than 5.

items.prompt: Write an inequality for "a number x is at most 10."
items.rationale: "At most" means less than or equal to: x <= 10.

items.prompt: What is the solution to x - 3 < 7?
On a number line, an open circle at a point represents:

choices.A: The point is included in the solution
choices.B: The point is not included in the solution

items.rationale: Open circles show strict inequalities (< or >), where the boundary point itself is excluded.

items.prompt: Which situation could be modeled by the inequality x >= 12?

choices.A: You must be at least 12 years old to ride
choices.B: You must be exactly 12 years old to ride
choices.C: You must be younger than 12 to ride
choices.D: You must have at most 12 items
